risk_summary: The disclosure is relatively quantitative regarding revenue, gross profit, market exposure, and COVID-19 impacts, but includes substantial forward-looking caveats and generalized uncertainty language. Key risks include cyclical industrial demand, project delays or cancellations, commodity-price volatility, customer capital-spending deferrals, margin pressure, and potential tax-asset realization uncertainty.
